rule: Automatic findings are candidates for human review, not product verdicts. A normalized selection result may pass the structural release gate only when every fixture conforms, wrongTarget is zero, and falseSuccess is zero. No model output is stored in this ledger.

entrySchema.date: ISO date of the human ruling
entrySchema.evidence: what the human saw in the normalized evaluation evidence
entrySchema.ruling: why this is a checker defect or a product-selection defect
entrySchema.action: checker revision, tier change, or re-run status
